title.label: Amazing in concept, gate kept by native voice

content.label:
I really wanted to like this app. The transcription is easily 10x better than native iOS speech to text. Still makes mistakes on words like innocuous. 

But the keyboard switching solution is so janky. Half the time one pushes the wrong button and it opens the app kicking me out of whatsapp or iMessage completely. I don’t need an onscreen keyboard too. I need a giant microphone button and zero areas that kick me out of what we app I’m using just because I’m using the phone one handed while pushing a stroller
